aggregate.important_nonclaim: This does NOT establish a polynomial algorithm for arbitrary 3CNF/SAT. The polynomial bound depends on successful admission into the preregistered fixed-width tree-composite scope and frozen local exact mechanisms.
aggregate.statement: T_total(N) <= poly(N) for this frozen fixed-width scoped implementation/family

scope: preregistered v1.2/v1.3 mixed tree-composite family; selected RHO_W1; fixed lower primitive library P0..P8

certificate.SAT: local witnesses + compatible tuple choices; polynomial-size for R leaves
certificate.UNSAT: local restricted certificates for forbidden tuples + global relational elimination trace; fixed tuple bound keeps total certificate polynomial

component_relation.bound: O(2^w * poly(N_leaf)); constant-factor bounded under fixed w
component_relation.selected: at most 2 boundary tuples per W1 leaf

interaction_graph.reason: pairwise leaf-boundary intersection construction over R leaves; accepted target requires a tree and total boundary<=3

lower_primitive_execution.reason: P0/P4 relation+augmenting-path path, P1/P5 implication graph/SCC path, P2/P6 finite fixed-point propagation path, P3/P7 bounded local truth-table extraction (local width<=3 so <=8 assignments) plus GF(2)-style elimination; P8 root replay

normalize.reason: deduplicate/canonical-sort literals and clauses; no combinatorial assignment search

reconstruction.reason: walk chosen tree entries, merge local assignments, then replay original root CNF

root_replay.reason: direct clause evaluation under reconstructed assignment

structure.bound: polynomial in N for fixed w
structure.generic_preregistered_detail: for fixed w<=3, candidate separator count is O(V^w), still polynomial; no optimization over growing w
structure.selected_detail: RHO_W1 tests at most V singleton separators per recursive region. Each candidate performs finite primal-connectivity/clause ownership scans. Recursive splitting yields at most O(M) nonempty leaf regions/internal split events. Therefore total structure discovery is polynomial.

synthesis.reason: exactly 3 frozen rule candidates evaluated on fixed calibration population; no unbounded program enumeration and no search-until-holdout-passes

transfer.bound: O(R * c_w^2) up to representation overhead, with c_w<=2^w
transfer.reason: tree dynamic programming/messages over R-1 edges; bounded explicit relations, no exponential growth in R
